yoel: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GPU surge & regional routing. dropping a thread for Qs.
mae: APAC T4 pilot ETA? Teams want a concrete window for testing.
yoel: Target mid-July for APAC burst pockets; Dedicated reservations late Q3. We'll publish zones next Tue.
priya: Autoscaler ordering? need to configure fallback for latency-critical routes.
yoel: Order is reserved -> prewarm -> burst(spot/partner) -> model fallback (quantized/smaller). Keeps p95 stable.
sasha: If spot is evicted, do we retry or immediately downgrade model?
yoel: We attempt prewarm/reserved first, then switch to quantized variant. If none available, we queue briefly (200ms) then failfast.
mae: Ops needs prewarm defaults to place cloud capacity orders. Any numbers?
yoel: Defaults: 200 slots for major regions, APAC pilot 50. Adjust by expected QPS.
priya: Will Console expose prewarm/burst metrics? SRE wants per-route visibility.
ops-bot: Notes + deck -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-20 (deck v10.3).
yoel: Action items: publish GPU pressure playbook (owner: mae) by Friday; shared autoscaler example YAML; schedule 30m route-mapping sync Tue 10am PT. DM me route names if latency-critical. :thumbsup:
